test_case: OpenGeoSys LiquidFlow GravityDriven (official OGS benchmark, ctest LiquidFlow_GravityDriven)

engine.name: OpenGeoSys
engine.binary: ogs (serial, pip wheel build); vtkdiff for the official check
engine.license: BSD-3-Clause style (OpenGeoSys LICENSE.txt, Copyright (c) 2012-2026 OpenGeoSys Community)

simulation.domain: 2D box 1 m x 1 m, 409 nodes, 736 triangles
simulation.boundary: Dirichlet p = 0 at top corners (0,1) and (1,1)
simulation.time: t 0 -> 1 s, one Backward Euler step
simulation.reference: analytic hydrostatic pressure and zero Darcy velocity, stored in mesh2D.vtu (AnalyticPressure, v_ref)
